name: Dr.Bob
tagline: A chat-based triage assistant that finds nearby clinics and shares your medical profile when you request care.

awards: Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité

problem: When sick, people do not want to navigate health portals or wait on hold.
solution: Symptom triage chat, location-aware clinic search, a private medical profile to share with clinics, and a list of trusted clinics.
demo_moment: Team-described: describe symptoms and send an appointment request.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Dialogue - Sponsor Challenge // Dialogue - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Designed to feel as easy as texting a friend.

lessons: A calm interface matters most for a user who feels unwell.
